meta.description: Walpole furniture movers for single pieces and full rooms: wrapped, carried, taken apart and rebuilt by our own crews. 2-hour minimum. Free quote.

overview: A new sectional, a dining table from a relative, a bed that will not go up the stairs in one piece: plenty of Walpole jobs are about furniture rather than a whole household.
Our furniture movers wrap it, take it apart if it has to come apart and put it back together where it is going.
sellingPoints: Beds and tables taken apart and rebuilt

servicesBlock.h2: Single Pieces to Full Households in Walpole
servicesBlock.intro: Furniture-only jobs sit next to full local moves, packing and storage on the list below. A small job can grow into a bigger one if you need it to, and a heavy piece like a piano has its own service. Furniture-only moves are billed by the hour like any local move, so you only pay for the pieces on your list and the drive to reach them.

whyChoose.h2: Why Walpole Customers Book Our Furniture Movers

cards.title: Taken Apart, Put Back
cards.text: Bed frames, tables and desks that will not fit through a doorway are disassembled for the carry and reassembled at the other end.

cards.title: Wrapped and Strapped
cards.text: Each piece goes into blankets and shrink wrap first, and straps keep it from shifting in the truck. Glass tops and mirrors get wrapped on their own.

cards.title: One or Two Pieces Is Fine
cards.text: A single armchair is still a job for us. It falls under a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time.

cards.title: Store and Seller Pickups
cards.text: Bought something from a store or a private seller? Send the pickup address and the crew collects it for you, then carries it to the room you want.

faqHeading: Questions About Moving Furniture in Walpole

faq.q: Can you deliver a sofa I bought to my Walpole home?
faq.a: Yes. Give us the pickup address and yours, and the crew collects it, wraps it and carries it in. Measure the doorways first if the piece is large.

faq.q: Do you take beds apart in Walpole?
faq.a: Yes. The crew disassembles beds and other furniture that need it and puts them together in the new room. Bolts and brackets stay with the piece they came from.

faq.q: How is a furniture-only move in Walpole billed?
faq.a: Like any local job. Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time.

faq.q: Can you get heavy furniture up or down stairs in Walpole?
faq.a: Yes. Describe the stairs when you ask for a quote so the manager sends enough movers and the equipment for them.

faq.q: Can a Walpole furniture job include a few boxes?
faq.a: Yes. Add the boxes to your list when you request a quote and they ride along on the same truck.

faqClosing: For booking terms and payment, the FAQ page has the details.

closing.body: List the pieces, the pickup and drop-off addresses and a date. Photos of anything oversized help, along with a note about stairs or tight turns at either end. A manager sends back an hourly quote.
